name: Paraguay

flag.description: Three equal horizontal bands of red, white and blue, with the national coat of arms in the centre of the white band on the front and the treasury seal, a lion with a cap of liberty, on the back.
flag.symbolism: The colours are commonly said to stand for patriotism and courage (red), peace (white) and liberty (blue); the treasury seal's motto "Paz y Justicia" means "Peace and Justice".

hook: Paraguay looks like the Netherlands until you spot the emblem, and flip it over: it is the only national flag with a different design on each side.
trivia: Paraguay's flag is the only national flag whose two sides differ: the front shows the national arms and the back the treasury seal.
Guaraní, an Indigenous language, is spoken by most Paraguayans and is an official language alongside Spanish.
